# A heredoc is a program when its command is an interpreter given no
# program otherwise (`languages/shell:V139`). Quoted tags have no holes;
# an unquoted tag's `$VAR` and `${…}` are the host's, while ruby's own
# `#{…}` is ruby's. psql takes a database argument and still reads SQL.
python3 <<PY | python | <<'PY' | - | - | "import sys\nprint(sys.argv)\n"
ruby <<RB | ruby | <<RB | - | $HOME | "puts \"#{ENV['HOME']} $HOME\"\n"
psql <<SQL | sql | <<SQL | - | ${name} | "select count(*) from users where name = '${name}';\n"
node <<JS | js | <<'JS' | - | - | "console.log(process.argv.length)\n"
perl <<PL | perl | <<'PL' | - | - | "print \"hi\\n\";\n"
bash <<SH | shell | <<'SH' | - | - | "ls | wc -l\n"
